_how: Lessons made by the community, one entry per video. An entry shows on tauhud.com only when url is a YouTube link and checked is a date (facts reviewed). mission = an id from missions/index.html: vote, door, fail, bar, outage, stake; or "tau" for a Tau Language lesson (shows on /learn/ only). Example: {"mission": "fail", "title": "Why more than half is not enough", "by": "name the author chose", "url": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=...", "lang": "en", "checked": "2026-11-15"}
